integrity: Explicit proof and executable finite verifier included; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two agents; each agent has a disjoint set of size-two complementary pairs, with additive unit value for each completed pair. General matroid ranks, overlaps within agents, larger complements, more agents, and publication-priority certification are excluded. Finite exhaustive checks corroborate, but do not prove, the all-size theorem.
title: Exact fair-efficient allocation for two agents with disjoint complementary pairs
